verdict.rationale: First-party docs say the full LlamaCloud platform, including LlamaParse and LlamaExtract, can be deployed entirely in your own infrastructure as self-hosted or BYOC. Deployment uses Kubernetes and Helm charts on AWS, Azure or GCP, keeping data, models and infrastructure under the customer's control. Enterprise docs also list single-tenant, BYOC, self-hosting and regional endpoints. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of a self-hosted deployment, and detail on fully air-gapped or offline operation (e.g. whether model inference stays fully on-prem) and which plans include it.
